text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The grand year-end showdown, the Arima 
Kinen. A massive crowd gathered for the 
long-awaited clash between sisters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
True strength is the power to stand back 
up even after being crushed. From the 
fierce rivals she had met so far, that was 
what Narita Brian came to believe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wishing to walk forward with that same 
strength, she stepped up to face the race.
